name: Sahm indicator
rule: 3-month average of the unemployment rate minus its lowest 3-month average of the prior 12 months (points); amber >= amber, red >= red

name: SA initial claims 4-wk avg vs. 52-week low
rule: Latest 4-week average / lowest 4-week average of the prior 52 weeks - 1; amber >= 15%, red >= 25%

panel_note: removed from the panel (stage 3b review); still a stage 3c score candidate
name: SA initial claims 4-wk avg vs. a year ago
rule: Latest 4-week average / the 4-week average 52 weeks earlier - 1; amber >= 10%, red >= 20%

name: SA continued claims vs. a year ago
rule: 4-week average of SA continued claims / the same average 52 weeks earlier - 1; amber >= 10%, red >= 20%

panel_note: context only (Leading page); not in the overall status
name: Temporary help jobs, 6-month change
rule: Latest month / 6 months earlier - 1; amber below 0, red below -3%

name: Yield curve (10y - 3m)
rule: Monthly average spread. Amber: below 0 for 3+ months in a row (amber = that many months). Red: the 12 months (red = that many months) after a qualifying inversion ends

panel_note: context only (Leading page); not in the overall status
name: Regional manufacturing surveys (Philly + Empire avg)
rule: Average of the Philadelphia Fed and Empire State general activity indexes (Philly alone before Jul 2001). Amber: below 0 for 3 months in a row; red: 3-month average below -15

name: Financial conditions (NFCI)
rule: Latest weekly NFCI (first release); amber above 0, red above 0.5
